## Decisions taken by the orchestrator (state them if challenged)

- Global scope counts the 15 skills on this machine (what the Library lists), not team.json's `global[]` (7), which is the "endorsed to Global" note.
- The sidebar reopen control sits in the top bar's left block after the Forward arrow (D9 named no position).
- The Library and Team section chevrons stay decorative; only Projects and Inbox fold.
- URL params `sidebar=hidden`, `projects=collapsed`, `inbox=collapsed` are applied to the view and never written to the persisted store.
